features.label: Adjustable polycentric hinges
features.text: Features four flexion stops (0, 45, 75, 90 degrees) and four extension stops (0, 20, 30, 40 degrees) plus a full-extension lockout to precisely control range of motion.

features.label: Cooltech antimicrobial fabric
features.text: Three-layer breathable material reduces heat retention and prevents odor buildup compared to standard neoprene.

features.label: Malleable rigid hinge arms
features.text: Rigid uprights conform to the patient's leg contour for an intimate fit without the need for heat molding.

features.label: Open popliteal design
features.text: Stretch material in the back of the knee eliminates bunching and irritation during flexion.

features.label: Removable universal buttress
features.text: Includes an Ossur 503000 buttress for customizable patella tracking support.

features.text: Verified adjustable knee brace with rigid hinged support for range of motion control and ligament stabilization.
